tasks.instruction: Suppose you are a student of a school. Write a formal letter to the headteacher asking for permission to start a reading club. Explain why you want the club and when it could meet.
tasks.answer:
20 November 2026
The Headteacher
Your School
Subject: Application for permission to start a reading club

Sir/Madam,
We, the students of Class Six, wish to start a reading club at our school. Many of us enjoy stories, but we need a place to share books and discuss them with friends. A reading club would help us improve our vocabulary and develop a regular reading habit.

We propose meeting in the library once a week after classes. We will follow the library rules and request a teacher to guide our activities. We will not allow the meetings to disturb our lessons.

We therefore request your kind permission to start the club.
Yours obediently,
Rina
On behalf of the students of Class Six

The identity and date are illustrative application details, not examination provenance.

tasks.instruction: Write a composition of about 200 words on Your School Library.
tasks.answer:
Your School Library

Our school library is one of my favourite places. It is a quiet room beside the teachers’ room. There are shelves of books along the walls and several tables where students can sit and read. The room has large windows, so it receives plenty of light during the day.

The library contains storybooks, dictionaries, magazines and books about science and history. Some books help us understand our lessons, while others introduce us to new places and people. I especially enjoy short stories because they are interesting and easy to carry home.

Our librarian helps us choose suitable books. Every student has a library card and can borrow books according to the school rules. We must return them on time, keep them clean and never tear or write on their pages. We should also speak softly so that other readers are not disturbed.

I visit the library at least once a week. Reading there improves my vocabulary and helps me learn things beyond my textbooks. Sometimes I discuss a book with my friends and we recommend stories to one another.

A good library makes school life richer. I hope our school can add more books and give every student enough time to use them. We should all help to protect this valuable place.
